title: The provider_sign_outs job
assertion: Every minute the platform job claims each due row, asks the provider for one global sign-out by the account's subject, and marks it done (`signed_out`, or `no_such_user`) or failed with the error's name; stopped between its transactions at each point it sends at most one more sign-out and loses none; its lines carry IDs and codes only, `security event: provider sign-out not delivered` at error for LATE and GAVE_UP with the cause's request ID, on which `ProviderSignOutNotDelivered` alarms, and `provider sign-outs run` once a run, whose absence for ten minutes alarms (`ProviderSignOutsNotRunning`); a step that fails does not stop the others; no account, subject, address or code rides in the job's payload
noFileReason: Synthetic accounts and a provider twin the tests make; no file.
